business_problem: BMO needed to simplify commercial-banking support because too many case types, forms, and legacy development patterns made self-service hard for customers and expensive for the bank to maintain.
solution_summary: BMO needed to simplify commercial-banking support because too many case types, forms, and legacy development patterns made self-service hard for customers and expensive for the bank to maintain. BMO Commercial Bank implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform and Customer Service Management. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Customer Service Management manages customer-support cases and self-service. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations before ServiceNow AI Platform and Customer Service Management routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running customer support and case management on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
